source.extraction: sed bounded line windows only; whole-file reads are forbidden by the task spec

bucketing.rule: Bucket per Step 1 by timestamp: (i) pre-remediation (<= 2026-09-13T~20:00Z), (ii) after the remediation stamps but pre content-verified deploy, (iii) after a content-verified deploy.

exclusionRules: grep/tool previews truncate at 500 chars with a [truncated] marker: that is the tool, not disk.
a row that quotes another row is not corruption.
hyphen-dropped IDs (RUFU-234 -> RUFU234) are the pre-fix space-loss signature, not post-fix evidence.
a candidate counts only when a whole run is absent OR duplicated with independently confirmable intent.

controls.control: status row written whole into the same file: byte-clean control
tool row written whole into the same file: byte-clean control, tool name intact
